deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 0 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"BIOS Characteristics Extension Bytes\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 0` output filtered to the `BIOS Characteristics Extension Bytes` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; assumes dmidecode prints a literal Extension Bytes label, which typical decoded output may not expose, and captures only one following line.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; correctly requires byte length/encoding and raw-first comparison but misclassifies capability.
historical_reviews.round_02: No additional exact-code technical record found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 0 BIOS Characteristics Extension Bytes have the approved length and bit content for the platform and persist unchanged after reboot.
original_method: Preserve the complete Type 0 structure through the approved script/tool path, obtain a documented raw or fully decoded representation of extension bytes, compare length/bits with the platform specification, reboot and repeat without discarding unknown bits.
manual_activity: A user approves the byte baseline and plan. Evidence capture and byte/decoded-bit comparison are automatable once the supported representation is confirmed.
required_inputs: Documented dmidecode or approved script representation
Validated tooling, reboot and OOB plan
safety_requirements: Do not claim raw-byte coverage from a grep that returns no literal field or only decoded text.
Preserve unknown/reserved bits and tool versions.
Stop on representation ambiguity, truncation, byte drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Confirm the tool's supported raw/decoded representation, collect complete Type 0 evidence, compare byte length/content and documented meanings before/after reboot.
Do not invent byte values/decoding, modify firmware or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve byte baseline, representation and reserved-bit semantics.
Resolve decoder/spec differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not reliable: dmidecode generally decodes extension bits within Characteristics rather than printing the literal item label, and -A1 cannot prove byte completeness; hidden errors/insecure transport are also rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the approved Type 0 script/tool, first confirm its version-specific raw or decoded coverage, archive complete output/errors and compare the supported representation before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The linked script, extension-byte scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define whether evidence is raw bytes or a lossless version-bound decode; retain length, all bits and unknowns, then compare against the platform baseline and across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 0 implementations containing extension bytes.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode/script and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SMBIOS Type 0 byte baseline and approved tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces a likely nonexistent label grep with representation-verified, length-aware evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; prevents falsely claiming raw-byte coverage from partial decoded text.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Byte baseline and supported evidence representation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Decoded feature names are not necessarily lossless raw-byte evidence unless tool behavior is verified.

project_override_considerations: A project may use an approved raw parser or lossless decoded representation. The report must state which one and cannot claim the other.
expected_evidence: Approval, byte/length baseline, representation and version identities
Complete pre-reboot Type 0/raw or lossless decoded evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion are coherent; the exact byte values and extraction representation are missing project/tool details, not contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target field semantics are identifiable. Tool representation must be confirmed for readiness but does not make the master case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its literal one-line grep while preserving read-only Type 0 collection.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps raw-first byte/length and reserved-bit controls while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Prevents decoded strings from being mislabeled as complete raw bytes.

review_improvement: Makes evidence completeness explicit for a field that common human-readable dmidecode output may not label directly.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once a supported representation is supplied, every core action is software-controlled after approval; missing tooling is readiness, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE applies rather than BLOCKED or PARTIAL.
